== Historical image ==
The E-marked PC face is present by 8 July 2018; the distinct D-E1 rendering was published 15 October 2024. The gameplay wording is unchanged; the later rendering capitalizes “Undercover”. The source images are retained on their File pages. The earlier image has no separate implemented GEMP state; the current family remains <code>2_80</code>.
